svg.title: FP8 prepared-feature trunk latency
svg.desc: FP8 prepared-feature reconstruction trunk latency; two model panels, four resolutions (720p, 1080p, 1440p, 4K). Scope: Prepared-feature reconstruction trunk only: DLL-extracted cubins replayed through the reconstruction trunk, four resolutions; excludes RGB front/back ends and DLL host/NGX. Device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, SM120, batch 1. Protocol: CUDA-event graph timing; 3 passes/graph; 20 warmup replays; 64 alternating paired samples (32 per order); 10 graph replays/sample. Small31 FP16 uses 64 candidate-only samples. Bars are per-case medians. Paired delta is the supplied candidate/reference paired median ratio minus 1; positive means longer candidate latency, negative means shorter. Ratios are supplied by the measurement summary and are not recomputed from aggregate medians. Legacy71: 74/74 boundaries byte-exact and finite. Small31 FP8: Small31 FP8 timing_only: candidate FP32 P.V/denominator vs 310.9.16 vendor Half-PV QMMA arithmetic; 19/34 boundaries differ, first b31.output; no equivalence claim and no tolerance. No performance, speedup or equivalence claim is made.
